backuprider.name: Back-Up Rider
backuprider.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

doubleevolutionpill.name: Double Evolution Pill
doubleevolutionpill.desc: Banish 1 Dinosaur monster and 1 non-Dinosaur monster from your hand and/or GY; Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Dinosaur monster from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only activate 1 "Double Evolution Pill" per turn.

eartheffigy.name: Earth Effigy
eartheffigy.desc: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of an EARTH Normal Monster.

elementsofthunderwaterandwind.name: Elements of Thunder, Water, and Wind
elementsofthunderwaterandwind.desc:
Activate this Skill while your LP are 1000 or less. You can Normal Summon "Suijin", "Kazejin", or "Sanga of the Thunder" without Tributing this turn, OR, if you control "Suijin", "Kazejin", and "Sanga of the Thunder", you can apply this Skill instead.
● Send as many cards on the field as possible to the GY, then Special Summon 1 "Gate Guardian" from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

eternalrest.name: Eternal Rest
eternalrest.desc: Destroy all monsters equipped with Equip Cards.

evilheroneoslord.name: Evil HERO Neos Lord
evilheroneoslord.desc:
"Elemental HERO Neos" (or 1 Fusion Monster that mentions it) + 1 Effect Monster on the field
Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion". Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. If this card is Special Summoned, or a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY while this card is on the field: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of it. You can only use this effect of "Evil HERO Neos Lord" once per turn.

filomessengerfurhire.name: Filo, Messenger Fur Hire
filomessengerfurhire.desc: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 monster "Fur Hire" from your hand, except "Filo, Messenger Fur Hire". If a monster "Fur Hire" is Special Summoned to your field while you control this monster (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 monster "Fur Hire" in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position, but place it on the bottom of the Deck if it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Filo, Messenger Fur Hire" once per turn.

geminiimps.name: Gemini Imps
geminiimps.desc: During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect that could make you discard when it resolves: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. Then draw 1 card.

goblinoutofthefryingpan.name: Goblin Out of the Frying Pan
goblinoutofthefryingpan.desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Negate the activation of a Spell Card and return it to the owner's hand.

goldenrule.name: Golden Rule
goldenrule.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Crystal" card.)
Place 2 "Crystal Beast" monsters from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells, then Special Summon 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your hand or GY with a different name than those cards, and if you do, equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. You can only activate 1 "Golden Rule" per turn.

goldmooncoin.name: Gold Moon Coin
goldmooncoin.desc: Add 2 cards from your hand to your opponent's hand, then draw 2 cards. You can only activate 1 "Gold Moon Coin" per turn.

guardianofthethroneroom.name: Guardian of the Throne Room
guardianofthethroneroom.desc: A robot guard built to protect throne rooms, it is armed with homing missiles.

invocationsword.name: Invocation - "Sword"
invocationsword.desc: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control. If Summoning an "Invoked" Fusion Monster this way, you can also return monsters from any banishment to the GY as material. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can target 1 "Aleister" monster or "Invocation" in your GY; shuffle this card into the Deck, and if you do, add that target to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Invocation - "Sword"" once per turn.

juttefighter.name: Jutte Fighter
juttefighter.desc: Once per turn, you can change 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls to face-up Defense Position.

leetheworldchalicefairy.name: Lee the World Chalice Fairy
leetheworldchalicefairy.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "World Chalice" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 monster from your hand or field to the GY; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Lee the World Chalice Fairy" once per turn.

performapalsellshellcrab.name: Performapal Sellshell Crab
performapalsellshellcrab.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
Once per turn, when a "Performapal" monster you control is destroyed by battle: You can target 1 "Performapal" or "Odd-Eyes" card in your Pendulum Zone; Special Summon it.

[ Monster Effect ] 
Once per turn: You can target 1 Pendulum Monster you control; it gains 300 ATK for each "Performapal" monster you currently control, until the end of this turn.

predaplantdrosophyllumhydra.name: Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra
predaplantdrosophyllumhydra.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or GY) by Tributing 1 monster on either player's field with a Predator Counter. You can only Special Summon "Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra" once per turn this way. If this card is on the field or in your GY (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 other "Predaplant" monster from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 500 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra" once per turn.

rockbombardment.name: Rock Bombardment
rockbombardment.desc: Send 1 Rock monster from your Deck to the GY; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

scarredwarrior.name: Scarred Warrior
scarredwarrior.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Your opponent cannot target face-up Warrior-Type monsters for attacks, except this one. Once per turn, if this card would be destroyed by battle, it is not destroyed.

spellbookstarhall.name: Spellbook Star Hall
spellbookstarhall.desc: Each time a "Spellbook" Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card. All Spellcaster-Type monsters you control gain 100 ATK for each Spell Counter on this card. When this card with Spell Counter(s) is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck to your hand, whose Level is less than or equal to the number of Spell Counters that were on this card.

stripingpartner.name: Striping Partner
stripingpartner.desc:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by the following effect. If the effect activation of a monster you control is negated (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Striping Partner" once per turn.

sylvandancepione.name: Sylvan Dancepione
sylvandancepione.desc:
2 Plant monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can choose a number from 1 to 3 and excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, and if you do, you can Special Summon up to 2 excavated Plant monsters, but they cannot be used as Link Material, also send the remaining cards to the GY. You can target 1 Plant monster in your GY that has a Level; the Levels of monsters this card points to become that monster's Level, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Sylvan Dancepione" once per turn.

ukanomitsunenoonari.name: Ukanomitsune-no-Onari
ukanomitsunenoonari.desc:
2 LIGHT monsters, including a Beast monster
Your opponent cannot target cards in the Field Zones with card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ukanomitsune-no-Onari" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can target 1 Quick-Play Spell in your GY; Set it. If this card is destroyed: For each card in a Field Zone, you can apply 1 of these effects. (If both, apply them in sequence.)
● Destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
● Inflict 1500 damage to your opponent.

wetha.name: Wetha
wetha.desc: A spirit that controls rain and is capable of summoning hurricanes to blow the enemy away.

wowwarrior.name: Wow Warrior
wowwarrior.desc: A fish with arms, legs, and some very sharp teeth.
